name: agent-eval-lab
description: Run a task suite against several Hermes Agent configurations and tell which one is better, and how sure we are.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @eval-lab/shared build && pnpm --filter @eval-lab/web build && pnpm --filter @eval-lab/api build
scripts.eval:ci: pnpm --filter @eval-lab/shared build && pnpm --filter @eval-lab/api build && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning apps/api/dist/cli.js
scripts.demo: pnpm --filter @eval-lab/shared build && pnpm --filter @eval-lab/api build && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning apps/api/dist/cli.js --demo
